principles.standing: coarse durable professional/social standing; not a mandatory job ladder
principles.responsibility: branching appointments/specializations can open independently of standing
principles.reach: capability/reputation/resources widen possible work without forcing title change
principles.underworld_form: gang, Mafia-style family, criminal dynasty, syndicate, criminal enterprise, network, crew are parallel forms; type is not a power rank and never auto-changes from scale alone
principles.underworld_membership_flow: headcount is a stock emerging from recruitment, desistance/defection/custody/death/relocation and movement between peripheral, active and core tiers; no target final size or small-gang growth ceiling
principles.underworld_scale: Gang manpower is resolved from operational footprint when unspecified; explicit headcounts override. Cale is a ward-gang-scale case, not a universal small-gang template.
